title: Concept-Grounded Attention: A Controlled Evaluation of Graph-Injected Attention, Temporal Versioning, and Epistemic Status
abstract: arXiv:2609.38684v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge-intensive language-model systems typically represent external knowledge as text chunks or static graphs, with limited support for concept evolution, point-in-time reasoning, and distinctions between validated and inferred knowledge. We introduce the Concept Lifecycle Model (CLM), which represents concepts as persistent, graph-grounded, temporally versioned entities with explicit provenance and epistemic status, and Concept-Grounded Attention (CGA), which injects concept-graph structure into transformer computation through graph-biased self-attention (Form A) and gated cross-attention over concept nodes (Form B). We evaluate the framework in controlled settings using disabled-mechanism baselines. On 200 MuSiQue and HotpotQA questions with retrieval fixed, concept-graph retrieval recovers explicit multi-hop paths but does not improve evidence recall. Form A appears to steer attention, with 2.76 times more attention on gold than d

translated_title: 概念锚定注意力：图注入注意力、时间版本化与认知状态的受控评估
translated_abstract: 知识密集型语言模型系统通常将外部知识表示为文本片段或静态图，对概念演化、时间点推理以及区分已验证知识与推断知识方面的支持有限。我们提出了概念生命周期模型（CLM），它将概念表示为持久的、基于图结构的、按时间版本化的实体，并具有明确的来源信息和认知状态；同时提出概念锚定注意力（CGA），通过图偏置自注意力（形式A）和对概念节点的门控交叉注意力（形式B）将概念图结构注入transformer计算中。我们在受控环境下使用禁用机制的基线对该框架进行评估。在检索固定的条件下，针对200个MuSiQue和HotpotQA问题的测试表明，概念图检索能够恢复显式的多跳路径，但并不能提升证据召回率。形式A似乎能够引导注意力，其对正确答案的关注度是干扰项的2.76倍。
tldr: 提出概念生命周期模型（CLM）与概念锚定注意力（CGA），将带有时间版本、来源信息与认知状态的概念图结构通过图偏置自注意力和门控交叉注意力注入transformer，受控评估显示其能恢复多跳推理路径并有效引导注意力。
